About me

Structured thinking, creative delivery.

I graduated from the University of Ghana with a degree in Public Administration and Information Studies, then went straight into the Generation Ghana Digital Marketing Programme because I kept noticing the same thing: plenty of good businesses were doing good work quietly, with no one online to see it.

Today I work with brands on social media content, campaign planning, email marketing and basic SEO, and I bring my administrative side with me. That means content calendars that are actually followed, reports you can read without a decoder, and deadlines that hold. I'm still early in my career and honest about it; what I offer is care, consistency and a genuine appetite to learn your business before I market it.

  • I start by understanding your goals, not by posting.
  • Clear communication and organised, on time delivery.
  • Content built around your audience, not trends alone.
  • Always learning: new tools, new tactics, better results.

Strands & Events Website

Goal: give a growing beauty and events business a home online. I planned the page structure, wrote the brand story and service descriptions for wig installation, styling, customisation and event décor, then built it out on WordPress with the contact details visible on every screen.

Strands & Events Brand Identity

Goal: one recognisable look. I created the interlocking S&E monogram plus a serif wordmark, set a black, cream and gold palette, and produced ready to edit templates so the brand stays consistent across posts, flyers and the website.

Google Business Profile Setup

Goal: be found by people nearby. I set up and verified the listing: business category, address pin in Madina, Accra, opening hours, phone number, service list and photos, and now manage the profile so information stays current and reviews get replies.

Rebrand Teaser Campaign

Goal: build anticipation for the new identity. I designed a short story series in the new gold and neutral direction, led by an "It's official: we're rebranding" teaser, and sequenced the posts so the reveal landed with an audience that was already paying attention.

Fragrance by Adom Promo Flyer

Goal: turn scrolls into orders. I paired a soft, sunlit product image with elegant type, wrote a one line description of the fragrance, and made the next step obvious with a Shop Now button and a WhatsApp number for direct ordering.
